scope: Canonical q70/PoW26 two-segment CPU block-v4 real public-I/O fixture: file-backed staged core and recursive proofs, persisted bundle metadata, separately SHA-pinned candidate/final manifests and recursion policy, detached rehydration and fresh complete verification
limits: The 402.31-second wall and 14,192,869,376-byte max RSS are for the enclosing build-and-test command, not isolated proving or receiver measurements.

The fixture creates the candidate/final policy hashes and recursion-policy hash, then supplies those hashes separately to the detached receiver. A production verifier must obtain the pins from an independent policy source.
The receiver reconstructs a fresh runner Source from pinned ELF/input/oracle/schedule and performs bounded host replay before fresh proof verification; this is not succinct verification.
This qualifies two real-I/O segments with a zero-precompile first leaf and 51 terminal Keccak accesses, not the 218-segment mainnet block.
